evidence.quote: The second case is when inflation expectations threaten to become unanchored. If expectations were to begin to drift, the reality or expectation of a weak monetary policy response would exacerbate the problem.
I do not foresee that some all-powerful artificial intelligence will be able to perfectly balance the risks of doing too little or too much.
Of course, the right response to uncertainty is probably context specific and thus varies over time.
